title: ntopng Flow Summary Total Bytes Leaderboard
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ntopng:flow bytes_total=*
| stats sum(bytes_total) as total_value, avg(bytes_total) as avg_value by host_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks host values by total and average total bytes across ntopng flow summary events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `bytes_total` values for each ntopng flow summary event and review total and average total bytes by host.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total total bytes.
grandmaExplanation: It reviews which host shows the biggest total bytes numbers in your ntopng flow summary data.
